purpose: A bilingual administrative reference draft for application development and candidate name/code matching. It is not an officially verified OCHA gazetteer.

secondary.name: Open Admin Data - Afghanistan Administrative Divisions

primary.name: OCHA/HDX Afghanistan - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (COD-AB)
primary.source_authority: Afghanistan Geodesy and Cartography Head Office (AGCHO)
primary.notes: Official HDX/AGCHO dataset metadata confirms the historical COD-AB dataset and 34/401 coverage, but the accessible metadata describes a 2019-established dataset last reviewed in July 2024 and metadata last updated 2025-01-17. OCHA's separate status dashboard now reports Afghanistan COD-AB reference year 2026 with 34 ADM1/401 ADM2 features; its coverage dashboard lists the work status as In Progress. The 2026 dashboard summary does not expose row-level ADM2 P-code/name/parent data in the retrieved page. This draft therefore still lacks a verified 401-row comparison against the current COD-AB gazetteer.

official_status_dashboard.name: OCHA COD Status Dashboard
official_status_dashboard.interpretation: The status dashboard reports Afghanistan COD-AB reference year 2026 and 401 ADM2 features, while the separate coverage/work dashboard lists the Afghanistan update as In Progress. The accessible HDX/AGCHO dataset metadata still describes a 2019-established dataset last reviewed in July 2024, with metadata last updated 2025-01-17. These dashboard summaries do not provide the 401 row-level P-code/name/parent records needed for a reproducible comparison. Do not infer that the user-supplied v04 workbook is the 2026 COD-AB gazetteer, and do not mark row-level verification complete.

rules: Treat IDs from the secondary source as candidate identifiers only until checked against the OCHA COD-AB gazetteer.

Do not publish district-specific agricultural recommendations solely because an administrative code is present.
Keep this file separate from runtime advisory data until primary-source verification is complete.

notes: All 401 candidate ADM2 P-codes are present in the supplied workbook and all 401 parent province P-codes match.
